title: DIDM Wins “Best Digital Marketing Training Company” at Noida Education Conclave 2026
summary: A proud recognition at the Noida Education Conclave 2026 where Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing was conferred the title of 'Best Digital Marketing Training Company' by Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Minister Shri Yogendra Upadhyay.
content: Some moments are not just achievements—they are a reflection of years of effort, belief, and dedication. For everyone associated with the Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing (DIDM), this was exactly that kind of moment. At the Noida Education Conclave 2026, DIDM was honored with the title of 'Best Digital Marketing Training Company'. The award was presented by Shri Yogendra Upadhyay, Minister for Higher Education, Uttar Pradesh, in the presence of distinguished academicians, educational leaders, and policy makers from across India. This milestone honors DIDM's relentless dedication to delivering high-impact, career-defining practical digital education across 14+ campuses.

title: For the Third Time, DIDM Has Won the Prestigious ASSOCHAM Award!
summary: DIDM creates history by winning an apex trade honor from ASSOCHAM for the third consecutive time in a row, demonstrating unparalleled consistency in quality education.
content: Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing has had the distinct honor of receiving awards from ASSOCHAM, one of India's oldest and most respected apex trade bodies representing over 450,000 corporate members. In a significant achievement, DIDM received the award from ASSOCHAM for the third time in a row. For the first time in 2018, DIDM received the Most Promising Brand award. In 2022, DIDM was honored with the Eminent Fair Business Practices award. In 2023 at the 9th MSME Excellence Award summit, DIDM solidified its position as India's most trusted name in digital skill development.

title: DIDM Receives the Eminent Fair Business Practices Award by ASSOCHAM
summary: Awarded at the 8th ASSOCHAM MSMEs Excellence Awards held at Taj Mahal Hotel, New Delhi by Union Minister of State Mr. Bhanu Pratap Singh Verma.
content: In the hearts of the Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing (DIDM) family, 9 March 2022 will always remain a memorable milestone. On this day, DIDM received the prestigious and eminent Fair Business Practices Category of the Year Award at the 8th ASSOCHAM MSMEs Excellence Awards held at Taj Mahal Hotel, New Delhi. The honor was presented by Mr. Bhanu Pratap Singh Verma, Minister of State, Ministry of MSME, Government of India. The award recognizes DIDM's unyielding standard of transparent fee policies, zero deceptive job guarantees, and student-first educational ethics.

title: DIDM Grabs the Prestigious International Fame Awards 2021
summary: Felicitated by actor and philanthropist Sonu Sood as the premier digital marketing training institution in India.
content: DIDM has grabbed the prestigious International Fame Awards 2021 and was declared as the 'Best Digital Marketing Training Company'. Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing emerged victorious after evaluating institutes nationwide on training quality, live agency floor experience, and student placement metrics. Renowned actor and humanitarian Sonu Sood presented the golden trophy to the founders of DIDM, commending their vision to democratize digital marketing education.

title: DIDM Conferred WASME SME Excellence Awards 2021
summary: World Association for Small and Medium Enterprises recognizes DIDM's contribution to digital upskilling and small enterprise enablement.
content: The World Association for Small and Medium Enterprises (WASME) has awarded Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing with the SME Excellence Award 2021 in the category of 'Best Digital Marketing Training Company'. The ceremony took place on Thursday, December 23, 2021 at Mirza Ghalib Hall, Scope Convention Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. The honor recognized DIDM's dedicated initiatives in upskilling entrepreneurs, helping MSMEs build digital commerce funnels, and supplying skilled manpower to growing businesses.

title: DIDM Earns Prestigious Recognition in The Economic Times Changemakers for Driving AI-Powered Digital Education
summary: Economic Times Changemakers profiles DIDM's breakthrough AI-Genesis curriculum and Diploma in Digital Marketing Intelligence.
content: Artificial Intelligence is redefining the digital industry, and DIDM has taken a leadership role by embedding real-time AI tools into every core marketing discipline. The Economic Times Changemakers spotlighted DIDM for transforming vocational education by blending prompt engineering, automated lead routing, and generative ad creativity into a comprehensive diploma program.
